artifacts.notes: Current composite local-metre vectors, routing, RH 2000 terrain references and scenery inputs. Hole 9 Gul uses the explicit provisional DTM-bench control rather than the road-crossing card interpolation. Bunkers are measured sand (apply-sat-shapes.mjs from sat-shapes.json), no longer guide-formula placed. The 2026-09 surroundings pass (apply-surroundings.mjs) adds the gated Skagern ring at 69.3 m, traced ditches replacing the synthetic guide crossings, 86 laser-confirmed protected-tree crowns, the corrected range, the greenkeeping yard, Skagersvik context and synthesized village housing.

The 2026-09 surroundings pass adds OSM woodland cells and opens the Skagern ring, range, practice greens, parking and yard.

Parsed wide OSM surroundings, clipped to a 4.6 km keep box: the Skagern shoreline runs and islands, lakes, waterways, woodland/wetland/farmland multipolygons, roads, tracks, paths, the disused railway, buildings, parking, piers, the power corridor with towers, places and barriers. Read-by-eye satellite traces with per-feature confidence: the corrected driving range, practice greens, main parking, greenkeeping yard and its sheds, three ditch runs, two boundary walls, two jetties, a clear-fell ring and the manor precinct. Coordinates only; no imagery is redistributed.

Bunkers measured by per-pixel sand classification of Esri z18 imagery (detect-sand.mjs): 18 accepted sand bunkers with pixel-centroid positions and covariance axes, 11 rejected candidates and 5 guide-listed bunkers that resolved to no sand, all listed. Replaces the guide-formula placement in the compatibility model; coordinates only, no imagery stored.
